name: labs/nsls2__pamila
title: PAMILA read-only middle-layer variable list
intro: PAMILA read-only middle-layer variable list, adapted from nsls2/pamila. It reads `mlv_count`, `mlv_names`, `enabled_mlv_names`, `enabled_status` and 3 more. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/nsls2__pamila --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/nsls2__pamila --backend fake --mcp
